name: tackle_batch_execute
description: Apply 1..=32 undoable writes as one undo group, in order; the first failure rolls the whole batch back. Members: gameobject create/modify/delete, component add/remove, prefab instantiate.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key; semantics in the server instructions.

name: tackle_component_add
description: Add a component (type full name, e.g. UnityEngine.BoxCollider) to a GameObject. Undo-grouped.

component_type.description: Component type full name in the loaded assemblies.

path.description: Hierarchy path: non-empty, no empty segments, at most 1024 bytes.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key; semantics in the server instructions.

name: tackle_component_remove
description: Remove the first component of a type from a GameObject; the Transform cannot be removed. Undo-grouped.

component_type.description: Component type full name in the loaded assemblies.

path.description: Hierarchy path: non-empty, no empty segments, at most 1024 bytes.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key; semantics in the server instructions.

name: tackle_console
description: Read the connected Unity Editor's console entries, newest first: message, file, line, raw Unity LogEntry mode, identifier. max_entries is 1..500 (omit for the newest 100). Errors with `no editor connected` when no editor session is live.

name: tackle_editor_state
description: Read the connected Unity Editor's state: Unity version, project name and path, active scene name and path, isPlaying, isCompiling, editor command queue depth. Errors with `no editor connected` when no editor session is live.

name: tackle_gameobject_create
description: Create a GameObject in the active scene, optionally under a parent path. Undo-grouped; returns its properties.

name.description: Object name: non-empty, at most 256 bytes, no `/`.

parent_path.description: Parent path; omit for a scene root.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key; semantics in the server instructions.

name: tackle_gameobject_delete
description: Delete a GameObject and its children by hierarchy path. Undo-grouped: tackle_undo restores it.

path.description: Hierarchy path: non-empty, no empty segments, at most 1024 bytes.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key; semantics in the server instructions.

name: tackle_gameobject_modify
description: Modify a GameObject by path: active, name, tag, layer (by name), local position, rotation (Euler degrees), scale. Only given fields change. Undo-grouped; returns its properties.

path.description: Hierarchy path: non-empty, no empty segments, at most 1024 bytes.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key; semantics in the server instructions.

name: tackle_gameobject_properties
description: Read one GameObject's properties from the connected Unity Editor by hierarchy path (e.g. `Seraphine (factory)/Hips`): active flags, tag, layer, local and world transform, component type names, child count. Errors with `no editor connected` when no editor session is live, and with a plain editor error when the path resolves to nothing.

path.description: Hierarchy path; non-empty, no empty segments, at most 1024 bytes.

name: tackle_prefab_instantiate
description: Instantiate a prefab asset into the active scene, optionally under a parent path. Undo-grouped; returns the new object's properties.

parent_path.description: Parent path; omit for a scene root.

prefab_path.description: Prefab asset path: starts with Assets/, ends .prefab.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key; semantics in the server instructions.

name: tackle_project_info
description: Read the connected Unity Editor's project info: product and company name, bundle version, Unity version, project name and path, active build target, active scene, build scenes with their enabled flags. Errors with `no editor connected` when no editor session is live.

name: tackle_redo
description: Redo the last undone undo step; reports whether one was redone.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key; semantics in the server instructions.

name: tackle_scene_hierarchy
description: Read the active scene's GameObject hierarchy from the connected Unity Editor, preorder: name, active flag, child count, depth. Paginated: offset is zero-based, limit is 1..500 (omit both for the first page at the editor ceiling of depth 4 and 500 nodes); totalCount and truncation are reported. Errors with `no editor connected` when no editor session is live.

limit.description: Nodes per page, 1..=500. Omit for the editor default (500).

offset.description: Zero-based offset into the preorder node list. Must be >= 0.

name: tackle_scene_save
description: Save the active scene to its existing path; a never-saved scene is refused (tackle never invents a path).

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key; semantics in the server instructions.

name: tackle_script_create
description: Create a C# script under Assets/ (must not exist). Bounded filesystem write (PROGRAM exception class). Recompiles; reports compiled + error CS diagnostics.

contents.description: Full file contents, at most 65536 bytes.

path.description: Path relative to Assets/, ending .cs; no empty, `.` or `..` segments.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key; semantics in the server instructions.

name: tackle_script_patch
description: Patch a C# script under Assets/: replace old_text (must match exactly once) with new_text. Bounded filesystem write (PROGRAM exception class). Recompiles; reports compiled + error CS diagnostics.

path.description: Path relative to Assets/, ending .cs; no empty, `.` or `..` segments.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key; semantics in the server instructions.

name: tackle_selection
description: Read the connected Unity Editor's current selection: selected GameObjects with name, hierarchy path and active flag, the active object name, and the count of selected non-GameObject objects. Errors with `no editor connected` when no editor session is live.

name: tackle_undo
description: Undo the most recent undo step (a batch is one step); reports whether one was undone.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key; semantics in the server instructions.
